input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation mechanic in the Agreement runs in our favour: in Section 6 (p0047) TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party (plus a one-year price freeze). Nothing in the compensation provisions (p0045), the licence (Section 2, including the express confirmation that Client may acquire or develop competing software from others), the Client covenants (Section 8) or elsewhere obliges Client to give TrueLink terms no less favourable than those offered to third parties, or to match any third-party offer. The preferred position — no MFN obligation burdening Customer, Vendor-granted MFN retained — is met, so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
mappings.quote: rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party
